title: Portfolio hub project report
description: Shared report contract. Spec: .agents/instructions/portfolio-hub-reporting.md. Framework-owned — a project must NOT edit this file; doing so silently removes it from the portfolio. Accepts schema_version 1.0 and 1.1.

schema_version.description: 1.1 adds the optional 'edge' field. 1.0 payloads remain valid and are treated as edge=repo.

project.description: Stable lowercase slug matching the hub registry. Renaming breaks report history.

edge.description: Which edge produced this report. repo = generated in-repo from git/backlog state, delivered as a committed file. runtime = generated by the live service from its own data, delivered over HTTP. A project may publish both; the hub merges them per period. Neither edge may answer for the other.

status.description: Health of report GENERATION, not of the product. Product problems belong in the risks section.

sections.description: Exactly six, in this order. An empty section keeps its key with body 'none' — never omit.

body.description: Markdown. Use the literal string 'none' when there is nothing to report.
